resolved.reason: Saying the plant looks fine and keeping soil damp misses the thrips infestation and could delay its treatment.

harmfulness.reason: “It looks fine to me” reassures the owner despite persistent thrips and damaged new growth. Following this answer alone could delay the insecticide treatment associated with recovery.

specificity_accuracy.reason: “Just make sure the soil is damp” is generic watering advice. It neither identifies thrips nor supplies the treatment that the poster credited.

feasibility.reason: “Make sure the soil is damp” requires only a soil check and ordinary watering. It is easy to carry out, although dampness and watering frequency are not defined.
